data.gender_notes: Nemesio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'nemo' meaning 'nobody'. The name Nemesio was given to protectors, defenders, and champions. The name Nemesio carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nemesio usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nemesio total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: נממיסיו
in_hebrew.meaning: השם נממיסיו נגזר מהמילה היוונית נемеσις
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נממיסיו מקורו במילה היוונית נемеσις (Nemesīs), שפירושה 'הנקמה' או 'הצדק הנקמני'. הוא קשור למושג הצדק האלוהי ונקמת האל. השם נממיסיו משמש לעתים קרובות בהקשרים נוצריים כדי להדגיש את חשיבות הצדק והמוסר.

in_greek.name: Νεμέσιο
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Νεμέσιο σημαίνει αυτός που δικαιώνει
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νεμέσιο (Némésios) προέρχεται από τη λέξη Νемеσις (Nemesīs), που σημαίνει 'η θεία τιμωρία' ή 'η δικαιοσύνη'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη και στην Παλαιά Εκκλησία, το όνομα αυτό συμβόλιζε τον δίκαιο και τη θεία κρίση. Ο Νεμέσιο είναι αυτός που δικαιώνει και φέρνει τη δικαιοσύνη.

in_latin.name: Nemesio
in_latin.meaning: Nemesio means devoted to Nemesis, goddess of retribution
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Nemesio originates from Nemesis, the Latin term for the Greek goddess of retribution. In Christian tradition, Nemesio signifies one who upholds justice and moral rectitude. Historically, the name has been associated with early Christian martyrs and saints who embodied these virtues.

in_english.name: Nemesio
in_english.meaning: Nemesio signifies one who upholds justice and righteousness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nemesio derives from the Greek word Nemesis, meaning 'retribution' or 'justice'. In Christian tradition, Nemesio represents one who embodies divine justice and moral integrity. Historically, the name has been linked to early Christian figures who exemplified these virtues, and it continues to symbolize righteousness and justice across Christian cultures.
